copy.tagline_en: Write IndexedDB migrations to safely transform persisted data between versions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to migrate IndexedDB data between Trezor Suite versions

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 指导你为 Trezor Suite 创建 IndexedDB 存储迁移。它会帮你生成文件、编写数据转换逻辑（如添加字段、删除记录）并更新日志。
howto.when: 当你需要编写将持久化数据从旧版转换为新版格式的 IndexedDB 迁移时触发。

say.text: 在 devices 存储中为所有记录添加 default 字段。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create and implement IndexedDB storage migrations for Trezor Suite. It guides you through scaffolding files, writing data transformation logic (e.g., adding fields, deleting records), and updating changelogs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to write an IndexedDB migration that transforms persisted data between Suite versions.
